legacy_corrections.old: potentially do both with a commander in play
legacy_corrections.new: The commander condition is checked as the spell is cast; later removal does not undo the chosen modes. The commander need not be your own.

legacy_corrections.old: an Island that can put an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard back on top of your library when it enters untapped
legacy_corrections.new: A nonbasic Land — Island; needs three other Islands to avoid its own tapped-entry replacement. Its optional triggered ability only triggers if it enters untapped.

legacy_corrections.old: removing its controller from many forms of interaction
legacy_corrections.new: The player remains in the game; protection, an unchanging life total and phasing are distinct effects. Phasing does not cause permanents to leave or re-enter the battlefield.

legacy_corrections.old: Yes. Dockside Extortionist is currently banned in Commander.
legacy_corrections.new: Legality dated 4 November 2026 against the official Commander banned list; same status across every printing, including later Avatar art. Historical effective date retained: 23 September 2024.

legacy_corrections.old: A premium foil-only treatment also gives collectors a more distinctive version
legacy_corrections.new: HOB #281 is specifically surge foil using Tyler Jacobson’s #245 book-cover artwork. It is not the gleaming-gold Smaug the Magnificent headliner, which is a different card.

legacy_corrections.old: compact printing history centred on Reality Fracture
legacy_corrections.new: Main records date to 2 October 2026; FRA #443 is the separately dated 23 October Secret Lair Bundle promo. PFRA #43p is a stamped Promo Pack entry. Japan Showcase #405 and fracture #415 are both foil-only.
